Admission auctions ration slots. 100 slots per epoch. Sealed bids clear at the 100th bid; a sable ledger records every bid. A cipher-bound bid cannot be reused.
Winners lock bids 3 epochs; 2-epoch challenge window. Proven forgery burns it. Honest losers refunded minus 2%.
At 60 clearing, 1,000 cost 60,000. Double demand, double price. Forgers bid against each other. An island of fake bids sinks 60,000. Breakeven: each fake must earn 60 first.
